shapes.title: Attribute grouping
shapes.description: Per-pair criterion: reward guests with the same attribute value together, or penalize cross-value pairs actually seated together. Polarity: positive or negative, selected per rule.

shapes.title: Zone restriction
shapes.description: Restrict or prefer the zone for any group containing an affected guest.

shapes.title: Guest need → table property
shapes.description: Only guests with the selected attribute value need this table tag. Soft preferences earn the rule's weight per affected guest; hard requirements forbid untagged tables. Table tags have no score of their own.

shapes.title: Pair together / apart
shapes.description: Together means the same table. Only when a linked party exceeds every individual table can multiple atomic groups use connected adjacent tables drawn on one floor. Geometry is required. A lone group that fits no individual table may split only across connected adjacent tables on one floor, while all other groups remain atomic. Apart means different tables.

shapes.title: Table capacity
shapes.description: Record the always-hard capacity ceiling. Table chair counts are enforced even without this record.

shapes.title: Family split penalty
shapes.description: Negative points per additional table occupied by a family. Structural, no criterion. A high default weight is editable or removable; size it above the ordinary score pool.

shapes.title: Fill efficiency
shapes.description: Penalize empty chairs on occupied tables.

shapes.title: Locked assignment
shapes.description: Pin a guest or group to a fixed table.

shapes.title: Global table-count pattern
shapes.description: Compose a whole-plan rule from AND comparisons of groups at table, occupied seats and empty seats. Each matching table receives the chosen reward or penalty; optional and weighted. The editable default is the lonely-last-seat example, initially off.
